nodes.title: Supported Ramp integration
nodes.summary: Public API and sandbox feasibility checked
nodes.detail: Reviewed Bill Pay, vendor credits, comments, Blank Canvas, OAuth, Custom Records, CLI and MCP. No public arbitrary-page embedding interface was identified. Native comments are the first bounded write target.

nodes.title: Signed authority & isolation
nodes.summary: Enrolled keys, scoped mandates and replay controls
nodes.detail: Implemented reviewer proof, tenant/source separation, signed event scope, nonce/body/origin binding, immutable reservations and conservative release gates. Local operator custody remains a deployment trust assumption.
nodes.next_action: Retest every composed financial workflow.

nodes.title: Deterministic contract engines
nodes.summary: Typed money, terms, deadlines and exclusions
nodes.detail: Supported rule families cover amendment chains, pricing tiers, fee exclusions, complete monthly evidence and exact fractional-time arithmetic. Unsupported semantics remain quarantined. This covers a bounded financial grammar.
nodes.next_action: Use new independent cases to measure remaining grammar gaps.

nodes.title: Native terms & price bindings
nodes.summary: Exact capture, bill, line and source identity
nodes.detail: Signed bindings connect supported contract terms to native records. Constructed USD800 terms over a real USD840 bill stay separately labelled as a hypothetical USD40 finding.
nodes.next_action: Provide authentic terms before establishing a live contractual finding.

nodes.title: Declarative vendor onboarding
nodes.summary: Real Opus proposal, compiler and lifecycle
nodes.detail: Generic source-grounded adapters support defined monthly and resource/service-month families. Intake, tests, shadow, interpretation, activation and rollback use the normal application. Tests use explicitly scripted reviewers.
nodes.next_action: Complete independent new-case acceptance and obtain human promotion.

nodes.title: Signed dispute inbox
nodes.summary: New messages and evidence reach a bounded evaluator
nodes.detail: Evidence requests, correct denials, rebuttals, partial awards and ambiguous clauses use typed validation and signed sources. Unknown substantive legal language escalates. External vendor communications require authorization.
nodes.next_action: Verify newly frozen denials through the full filing and response path.

nodes.title: Financial identity & source pins
nodes.summary: Four reproduced lifecycle defects corrected
nodes.detail: Independent verification passes distinct-resource totals, regional intake, compound-denial escalation and attribution after a lawful reply. Legacy delimiter collisions now refuse before financial writes. Ambiguous archive rows remain readable for review.
nodes.next_action: Keep original receipts immutable through later changes.

nodes.title: Credit reconciliation & attribution
nodes.summary: Award → native credit → applied bill stages
nodes.detail: Implemented native observation joins, independent original-filing and award witnesses, amount/currency bounds and allocation controls. The actual sandbox contains zero credits and the installed workspace has zero awards.
nodes.next_action: Supply a genuine award and credit before claiming an actual application.

nodes.title: Native writeback implementation
nodes.summary: Exact-object review, dispatch and readback
nodes.detail: Fixed redacted bill comments use separate effect authorization, a durable outbox and same-thread reconciliation. Blank Canvas validates active trigger and reset state. Controlled-provider tests verify transport behavior.
nodes.next_action: Execute only after the real scope and workflow are configured.

nodes.title: Ramp administrator grants
nodes.summary: bills:write is absent from token grants
nodes.detail: The sandbox exchange reports read grants while write-only requests provide no reported write scope. Admin app settings and product entitlement cannot be distinguished from the token alone. The available sandbox browser is at sign-in.
nodes.next_action: Sign in and verify the app's allowed scopes and Bill Pay access.

nodes.title: Actual customer terms & evidence
nodes.summary: Live agreement list is empty
nodes.detail: Observed bills lack usable signed negotiated terms and sufficient line-level quantities. Authentic agreements, usage/fee facts and an authorized source binding are needed to establish a live entitlement.
nodes.next_action: Provide and attest the governing contract and necessary fee/usage records.

nodes.title: Live Ramp write & same-ID proof
nodes.summary: No live comment or draft write has occurred
nodes.detail: A real native write needs a granted scope and an exact reviewed object. The implementation supports readback and uncertain-delivery reconciliation. The current two-minute film shows a simulation-only note plan.
nodes.next_action: Run one permitted sandbox comment or safe draft action, then verify its real ID and readback.

nodes.title: Ground filing fields in signed sources
nodes.summary: All seven independent original filings and denials now reach the engine
nodes.detail: The completed service, fee and plan source-reference corrections are integrated at 877f427. Root passed 67 focused tests. The unchanged socket replay delivers all seven originals and denials. Further failures concern language coverage and are tracked separately.
nodes.next_action: Retain the authority and source-pinning regressions.

nodes.title: Independent onboarding & denial acceptance
nodes.summary: 8/8 arithmetic; 1/7 denial dispositions; 2/8 complete
nodes.detail: Unchanged additive inputs reached all 146 scheduled observations on 877f427. Results are 136 pass, 10 fail and zero unmeasured. All seven denials arrived, but only one expected disposition passed. Zero responses were executed. The original cohort remains 2/10 complete with incomplete historical evidence retained. This studied-family cohort does not measure unseen-vendor population success.
nodes.next_action: Run the same frozen cohorts over a real socket after the fix. Preserve every prior attempt.

nodes.title: Additional contract families

nodes.detail: The third independently chosen source remains refused. A wrapped no-minimum-duration clause exposes inconsistent whitespace handling. A separate proposed verification-authority category correctly remains unsupported. The onboarding owner is implementing only reviewed generic corrections and safe source-linked explanations.
nodes.next_action: Complete Opus55 review, generic negative tests and normal intake diagnostics. Preserve all original refusals.

nodes.title: Actual human adapter promotion

nodes.next_action: Review the source, customer overlay, shadow outcomes and exact adapter version before activation.

nodes.title: New vendor response coverage
nodes.summary: Six independently written replies safely abstain
nodes.detail: Independent diagnosis isolates decimal/period availability assertions, pronoun-qualified lateness, declarative missing-artifact requests and partial-award wording. The existing engine handles the corresponding supported workflows with its older grammar. Broader bounded language coverage requires review and new positive/negative controls. Monetary calculations remain deterministic.
nodes.next_action: Consult Opus on generic clause coverage, preserve unknown-clause escalation and rerun the same independent cases.
